objectives: Hear /s/ followed by /t/ and /r/ in taught words.
Blend all three consonants smoothly and in order.
Distinguish str from spr, spl, and st onsets.
Blend the onset with the rest of the word to identify it.
concepts: The initial str blend contains /s/, /t/, and /r/ in order.
All three consonants remain audible in the onset.
Do not insert a vowel between consonants.
The complete word confirms accurate blending.

definitions.definition: Two or more consonant sounds heard together at the beginning of a word.
A speech sound that can distinguish one word from another.
Joining speech sounds in order to say a word.

workedExamples.solution: Hear /s/ then /t/ then /r/, followed by the vowel and ending.
